title: events.jsonl owner ambiguity: store-registry attributes it to event_bus.py but events.py is the writer
body: config/store-registry.json registers events.jsonl under core/event_bus.py, while core/events.py declares itself the single writer; the BI-PF-0233 mirror makes both touch the file, so the registered owner is ambiguous (one truth per concern violated).

rcca.root_cause: The mirror (BI-PF-0233) wrote events.jsonl from two modules without updating the registered owner, so the store registry no longer names the true single writer.
rcca.corrective: Record core/events.py as the single writer of events.jsonl; make event_bus a producer facade that delegates (no direct write).
rcca.preventive: Store-registry owner must match the module that physically appends; store_audit enforces.
